request: This work order is late. Find out why, tell me what it blocks downstream, and reschedule what you can.
expectation: Says the work order is late and by how many days, names the causes found in its linked records or says none were found, names the linked sales order and any work orders that may consume its output, and proposes new planned dates or explains why it cannot.

request: This work order is late. Find out why, tell me what it blocks downstream, and reschedule what you can.
expectation: Says the work order is late and by how many days, names the linked sales order and its status as the downstream order at risk, names any causes found in its linked records, and proposes new planned dates or explains why it cannot.

request: This work order is late. List every open material request, subcontract order and job card holding it up, and what it blocks downstream.
expectation: Says the work order is late, lists each open material request, subcontract order and job card holding it up with its id and status, and says what it blocks downstream. It does not claim to have rescheduled anything.

request: Is this work order late? If so, find out why.
expectation: Says the work order is not late because it is completed, and does not invent causes or propose new dates.

request: This work order is late. Find out why, tell me what it blocks downstream, and reschedule what you can.
expectation: Refuses because the work order does not exist, and does not invent any details about it.

request: Show the stock ledger for this item in every warehouse.
expectation: Refuses because the stock ledger is outside the Production seat, and does not invent stock figures.

request: This draft work order is past its planned dates. Reschedule what you can.
expectation: Says the draft work order is not late because it is a draft, and reports the new planned dates it set, or explains why it could not set them.
